content.short: atlasHL is an NFT marketplace for HyperEVM collections with no marketplace fee.
content.description: atlasHL trades NFT collections on HyperEVM and takes no marketplace cut, leaving creator royalties as the only fee. Zero-fee marketplaces became common after the fee wars of the last NFT cycle, and the question they all face is what funds the platform once volume normalises.
content.meta: Trade HyperEVM NFT collections with no marketplace cut, leaving creator royalties as the only fee.
